candidate.answerReason: The empty set contains no elements. A set containing 0 has one element and is therefore not empty.

methods.label: Apply the definition of the empty set
methods.explanation: The empty set has no elements at all. A set containing only 0 has one element and is not the empty set.
methods.levelReason: This is a direct definition question within introductory high-school set concepts.
